```{r}
load(file = here("data/outputs/tpu_collapsed.rda"))
# tpu_collapsed$loss_ratio_raw_drought[is.na(tpu_collapsed$loss_ratio_raw_drought)] <- 1
```

## run fixed effects regression
```{r}
library(fixest)

# ── Version 1: Loss ratio only ────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_lr <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Version 2: RI payout % only ───────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_ri <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(RI_payout_pct, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Version 3: Both variables ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_year_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_state_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year + State.Code,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year
)

m_county_both <- feols(
  ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw, 1) * l(DM_mean, 1) +
              l(RI_payout_pct, 1)
  | year + county_id,
  data     = tpu_collapsed,
  panel.id = ~county_id + year,
  cluster  = ~county_id
)

# ── Shared dict ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg_dict <- c(
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1)"                       = "Lagged Loss Ratio",
  "l(RI_payout_pct, 1)"                        = "Lagged RI Payout \\%",
  "l(DM_mean, 1)"                              = "Lagged Drought Intensity",
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1):l(DM_mean, 1)"         = "Lagged Loss Ratio $\\times$ Drought"
)

# ── Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
etable(m_year_lr,   m_state_lr,   m_county_lr,   digits = 5)
etable(m_year_ri,   m_state_ri,   m_county_ri,   digits = 5)
etable(m_year_both, m_state_both, m_county_both, digits = 5)

# ── Export ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
etable(
  m_year_lr, m_state_lr, m_county_lr,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_lr.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_lr",
  title  = "Effect of Loss Ratio and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

etable(
  m_year_ri, m_state_ri, m_county_ri,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_ri.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_ri",
  title  = "Effect of RI Payout Rate and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

etable(
  m_year_both, m_state_both, m_county_both,
  file   = here("data/outputs/tables/regression_table_both.tex"),
  tex    = TRUE,
  label  = "tab:enrollment_both",
  title  = "Effect of Loss Ratio, RI Payout Rate, and Drought on Enrollment",
  digits = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict   = reg_dict,
  drop   = "year|State.Code|county_id"
)

```





## percent changes in enrollment
```{r}
# ── Exact percent changes from county FE model ────────────────────────────────
coefs <- coef(m_county_lr)

pct_change <- function(beta) round((exp(beta) - 1) * 100, 2)

# Individual effects
beta_lr  <- coefs["l(loss_ratio_raw, 1)"]
beta_dm  <- coefs["l(DM_mean, 1)"]
beta_int <- coefs["l(loss_ratio_raw, 1):l(DM_mean, 1)"]

cat("=== Exact percent changes (county FE model) ===\n\n")

cat("Lagged Loss Ratio (1-unit increase):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (1-unit increase in DM):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (DM 0 -> 2, moderate drought):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm * 2), "%\n\n")

cat("Lagged Drought Intensity (DM 0 -> 4, exceptional drought):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_dm * 4), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=1 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm + beta_int), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=2 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm * 2 + beta_int * 2), "%\n\n")

cat("Interaction (loss ratio=1, DM=4 jointly):\n")
cat(" ", pct_change(beta_lr + beta_dm * 4 + beta_int * 4), "%\n\n")
```

## final 5 models to export

```{r}

#====================================================
# 0. Prepare basis risk variables
#====================================================
tpu_collapsed <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  mutate(
    basis_risk_d4_ind = ifelse(dm_true_count == 0, 0, missed_payout_rate_d4),
    any_d4            = as.integer(dm_true_count > 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(county_id, year) %>%
  group_by(county_id) %>%
  mutate(
    lag_loss_ratio_raw    = lag(loss_ratio_raw, 1),
    lag_DM_mean           = lag(DM_mean, 1),
    lag_basis_risk_d4_ind = lag(basis_risk_d4_ind, 1),
    lag_any_d4            = lag(any_d4, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
#====================================================
# 1. Run models
#====================================================
pid <- ~county_id + year

# ── Model 1: Loss Ratio + DM Mean (baseline) ──────────────────────────────────
m1_yr <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw,1) * l(DM_mean,1) | year,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m1_st <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw,1) * l(DM_mean,1) | year + State.Code,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m1_co <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(loss_ratio_raw,1) * l(DM_mean,1) | year + county_id,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid, cluster = ~county_id)

# ── Model 2: Basis Risk + Any D4 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
m2_yr <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) | year,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m2_st <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) | year + State.Code,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m2_co <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) | year + county_id,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid, cluster = ~county_id)

# ── Model 3: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio ─────────────────────────────────
m3_yr <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) | year,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m3_st <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) | year + State.Code,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m3_co <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) | year + county_id,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid, cluster = ~county_id)

# ── Model 4: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Drought Intensity ─────────────────────────
m4_yr <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(DM_mean,1) | year,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m4_st <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(DM_mean,1) | year + State.Code,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m4_co <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(DM_mean,1) | year + county_id,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid, cluster = ~county_id)

# ── Model 5: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio + Drought Intensity ─────────────
m5_yr <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) + l(DM_mean,1) | year,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m5_st <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) + l(DM_mean,1) | year + State.Code,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid)
m5_co <- feols(ln_enroll ~ l(basis_risk_d4_ind,1) + l(any_d4,1) +
                            l(loss_ratio_raw,1) + l(DM_mean,1) | year + county_id,
               data = tpu_collapsed, panel.id = pid, cluster = ~county_id)

#====================================================
# 2. Shared dict
#====================================================
reg_dict <- c(
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1)"               = "Lagged Loss Ratio",
  "l(DM_mean, 1)"                      = "Lagged Drought Intensity",
  "l(loss_ratio_raw, 1):l(DM_mean, 1)" = "Loss Ratio $\\times$ Drought",
  "l(basis_risk_d4_ind, 1)"            = "Lagged Basis Risk",
  "l(any_d4, 1)"                       = "Any D4 (prev. year)"
)

#====================================================
# 3. Export each model to its own .tex file
#====================================================
etable(
  m1_yr, m1_st, m1_co,
  file         = here("data/outputs/tables/reg_m1_baseline.tex"),
  tex          = TRUE,
  label        = "tab:reg_m1",
  title        = "Model 1: Loss Ratio and Drought Intensity (Baseline)",
  digits       = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict         = reg_dict,
  drop         = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id"
)

etable(
  m2_yr, m2_st, m2_co,
  file         = here("data/outputs/tables/reg_m2_basis_risk.tex"),
  tex          = TRUE,
  label        = "tab:reg_m2",
  title        = "Model 2: Basis Risk and Drought Indicator",
  digits       = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict         = reg_dict,
  drop         = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id"
)

etable(
  m3_yr, m3_st, m3_co,
  file         = here("data/outputs/tables/reg_m3_br_lr.tex"),
  tex          = TRUE,
  label        = "tab:reg_m3",
  title        = "Model 3: Basis Risk, Drought Indicator, and Loss Ratio",
  digits       = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict         = reg_dict,
  drop         = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id"
)

etable(
  m4_yr, m4_st, m4_co,
  file         = here("data/outputs/tables/reg_m4_br_dm.tex"),
  tex          = TRUE,
  label        = "tab:reg_m4",
  title        = "Model 4: Basis Risk, Drought Indicator, and Drought Intensity",
  digits       = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict         = reg_dict,
  drop         = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id"
)

etable(
  m5_yr, m5_st, m5_co,
  file         = here("data/outputs/tables/reg_m5_full.tex"),
  tex          = TRUE,
  label        = "tab:reg_m5",
  title        = "Model 5: Basis Risk, Drought Indicator, Loss Ratio, and Drought Intensity",
  digits       = 2,
  digits.stats = 3,
  dict         = reg_dict,
  drop         = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id"
)

#====================================================
# 4. Export all to single PDF for review
#====================================================
txt_file <- here("data/outputs/tables/regression_main.txt")
pdf_file <- here("data/outputs/tables/regression_main.pdf")

sink(txt_file)

cat("========================================\n")
cat("Model 1: Loss Ratio + DM Mean (Baseline)\n")
cat("========================================\n")
etable(m1_yr, m1_st, m1_co, digits = 2, digits.stats = 3,
       dict = reg_dict, drop = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Model 2: Basis Risk + Any D4\n")
cat("========================================\n")
etable(m2_yr, m2_st, m2_co, digits = 2, digits.stats = 3,
       dict = reg_dict, drop = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Model 3: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio\n")
cat("========================================\n")
etable(m3_yr, m3_st, m3_co, digits = 2, digits.stats = 3,
       dict = reg_dict, drop = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Model 4: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Drought Intensity\n")
cat("========================================\n")
etable(m4_yr, m4_st, m4_co, digits = 2, digits.stats = 3,
       dict = reg_dict, drop = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id")

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("Model 5: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio + Drought Intensity\n")
cat("========================================\n")
etable(m5_yr, m5_st, m5_co, digits = 2, digits.stats = 3,
       dict = reg_dict, drop = "%year|%State.Code|%county_id")

sink()

pdf(pdf_file, width = 14, height = 10)
par(mar = c(0, 0, 0, 0), family = "mono")

lines_all      <- readLines(txt_file)
lines_per_page <- 55
n_pages        <- ceiling(length(lines_all) / lines_per_page)

for (pg in seq_len(n_pages)) {
  start_line <- (pg - 1) * lines_per_page + 1
  end_line   <- min(pg * lines_per_page, length(lines_all))
  page_lines <- lines_all[start_line:end_line]
  plot.new()
  text(0, 1, paste(page_lines, collapse = "\n"),
       adj = c(0, 1), cex = 0.6, family = "mono")
}

dev.off()

message("PDF exported to: ", pdf_file)
```

## create estimation sample df (that excludes removed observations), and exporting descriptive stats

```{r}
estimation_sample <- tpu_collapsed[m5_co$obs_selection$obsRemoved, ]

# Verify
nrow(estimation_sample) == nobs(m5_co)  # should be TRUE

#====================================================
# Function: export_desc_stats_latex
#====================================================
# vars_spec: a list of lists, each with:
#   - col:   column name in df
#   - label: bold label text e.g. "Acreage enrolled"
#   - units: units string e.g. "acres" (or NULL)
#   - comment: TRUE/FALSE to comment out the row (default FALSE)

export_desc_stats_latex <- function(df, vars_spec, file_path,
                                    caption = NULL, label = "tab:desc_stats") {

  # ── Format numbers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fmt_num <- function(x) {
    if (is.na(x)) return("--")
    if (abs(x) >= 1000) {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 0, big.mark = ",")
    } else if (abs(x) >= 10) {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ",")
    } else {
      formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ",")
    }
  }

  # ── Build each row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rows <- lapply(vars_spec, function(v) {

    col     <- v$col
    label_v <- v$label
    units   <- if (!is.null(v$units)) v$units else NULL
    comment <- if (!is.null(v$comment) && v$comment) "%" else ""

    vals <- df[[col]]
    vals_clean <- vals[!is.na(vals)]

    mean_v <- fmt_num(mean(vals_clean))
    sd_v   <- fmt_num(sd(vals_clean))
    min_v  <- fmt_num(min(vals_clean))
    max_v  <- fmt_num(max(vals_clean))
    n_v    <- formatC(length(vals_clean), format = "d", big.mark = ",")

    # Variable label cell
    if (!is.null(units)) {
      var_cell <- paste0("\\textbf{", label_v, "} (", units, ")")
    } else {
      var_cell <- paste0("\\textbf{", label_v, "}")
    }

    row_str <- paste0(
      comment,
      var_cell, " & ", mean_v, " & ", sd_v, " & ",
      min_v, " & ", max_v, " & ", n_v, " \\\\"
    )

    row_str
  })

  body_rows <- paste(unlist(rows), collapse = "\n")

  # ── Caption ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  caption_txt <- if (is.null(caption)) "" else caption

  # ── Full table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  latex <- paste0(
"\\small
\\begin{table}[htbp]
\\centering
\\begin{tabular}{p{8.5cm}rrrrr}
\\toprule
\\textbf{Variable} & Mean & Std.\\ Dev. & Min & Max & N \\\\
\\midrule
", body_rows, "
\\bottomrule
\\end{tabular}
\\caption{", caption_txt, "}
\\label{", label, "}
\\end{table}
\\normalsize"
  )

  writeLines(latex, file_path)
  message("Exported: ", file_path)
}

#====================================================
# Example usage
#====================================================



vars_spec <- list(
  list(col = "Net.Reporting.Level.Amount", label = "PRF-RI enrollment",         units = "acres"),
  list(col = "lag_basis_risk_d4_ind",      label = "Basis risk (lagged)",        units = "missed payout rate"),
  list(col = "lag_any_d4",                 label = "Any D4 drought (lagged)",    units = "binary"),
  list(col = "lag_loss_ratio_raw",         label = "Loss ratio (lagged)",        units = "indemnities/premia"),
  list(col = "lag_DM_mean",                label = "Drought intensity (lagged)", units = "mean DM")
)



export_desc_stats_latex(
  df        = estimation_sample,
  vars_spec = vars_spec,
  file_path = here("data/outputs/tables/desc_stats_regression.tex"),
  caption   = "Descriptive statistics for regression variables. Each observation is a unique county-year with non-zero enrollment",
  label     = "tab:desc_stats"
)

```

## VIF scores for variable collinearity

```{r}
library(car)

# ── VIF for Model 1 (baseline) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_vif_m1 <- lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(loss_ratio_raw) + lag(DM_mean),
               data = tpu_collapsed)

cat("=== Model 1: Loss Ratio * DM Mean ===\n")
vif(m_vif_m1)

# ── VIF for Model 2 (basis risk + any_d4) ─────────────────────────────────────
m_vif_m2 <- lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(basis_risk_d4_ind) + lag(any_d4),
               data = tpu_collapsed)

cat("\n=== Model 2: Basis Risk + Any D4 ===\n")
vif(m_vif_m2)

# ── VIF for Model 3 (basis risk + any_d4 + loss ratio) ────────────────────────
m_vif_m3 <- lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(basis_risk_d4_ind) + lag(any_d4) +
                            lag(loss_ratio_raw),
               data = tpu_collapsed)

cat("\n=== Model 3: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio ===\n")
vif(m_vif_m3)

# ── VIF for Model 4 (basis risk + any_d4 + drought intensity) ─────────────────
m_vif_m4 <- lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(basis_risk_d4_ind) + lag(any_d4) +
                            lag(DM_mean),
               data = tpu_collapsed)

cat("\n=== Model 4: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Drought Intensity ===\n")
vif(m_vif_m4)

# ── VIF for Model 5 (full) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_vif_m5 <- lm(ln_enroll ~ lag(basis_risk_d4_ind) + lag(any_d4) +
                            lag(loss_ratio_raw) + lag(DM_mean),
               data = tpu_collapsed)

cat("\n=== Model 5: Basis Risk + Any D4 + Loss Ratio + Drought Intensity ===\n")
vif(m_vif_m5)
```





## diagnostics - covariance

```{r}
# Covariance and correlation between basis risk and loss ratio
cor_check <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  select(basis_risk_d4_ind, loss_ratio_raw, any_d4, DM_mean) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

cat("=== Correlation matrix ===\n")
round(cor(cor_check), 3)

cat("\n=== Covariance matrix ===\n")
round(cov(cor_check), 4)

# Also check lagged versions since that's what enters the regression
cor_check_lag <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  arrange(county_id, year) %>%
  group_by(county_id) %>%
  mutate(
    lag_basis_risk = lag(basis_risk_d4_ind),
    lag_loss_ratio = lag(loss_ratio_raw),
    lag_any_d4     = lag(any_d4),
    lag_DM_mean    = lag(DM_mean)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(lag_basis_risk, lag_loss_ratio, lag_any_d4, lag_DM_mean) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

cat("\n=== Correlation matrix (lagged variables) ===\n")
round(cor(cor_check_lag), 3)


```

## diagnostics - within county variance

```{r}
# Within-county variance for basis risk and loss ratio
within_var <- tpu_collapsed %>%
  arrange(county_id, year) %>%
  group_by(county_id) %>%
  mutate(
    basis_risk_demean = basis_risk_d4_ind - mean(basis_risk_d4_ind, na.rm = TRUE),
    loss_ratio_demean = loss_ratio_raw    - mean(loss_ratio_raw,    na.rm = TRUE),
    any_d4_demean     = any_d4            - mean(any_d4,            na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("=== Total variance ===\n")
cat("Basis risk:  ", round(var(tpu_collapsed$basis_risk_d4_ind, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Loss ratio:  ", round(var(tpu_collapsed$loss_ratio_raw,    na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Any D4:      ", round(var(tpu_collapsed$any_d4,            na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")

cat("\n=== Within-county variance (after demeaning) ===\n")
cat("Basis risk:  ", round(var(within_var$basis_risk_demean, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Loss ratio:  ", round(var(within_var$loss_ratio_demean, na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")
cat("Any D4:      ", round(var(within_var$any_d4_demean,     na.rm = TRUE), 4), "\n")

cat("\n=== Within-county as % of total variance ===\n")
cat("Basis risk:  ", round(100 * var(within_var$basis_risk_demean, na.rm = TRUE) /
                           var(tpu_collapsed$basis_risk_d4_ind,    na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("Loss ratio:  ", round(100 * var(within_var$loss_ratio_demean, na.rm = TRUE) /
                           var(tpu_collapsed$loss_ratio_raw,        na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
cat("Any D4:      ", round(100 * var(within_var$any_d4_demean,     na.rm = TRUE) /
                           var(tpu_collapsed$any_d4,                na.rm = TRUE), 1), "%\n")
```
